name: Warped creatures

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend (south and east)
locations.how: Reach the Catacombs of Kourend (e.g. Xeric's talisman or the Kourend entrances), then go to the southern or eastern chambers.
locations.note: Eastern chamber: safespot across the water in the south-east corner or nearby corners.

food.note: Max hit is only 10 and Protect from Melee stops all damage.

tips: Protect from Melee prevents all damage from warped jellies.
Safespot across the water in the eastern chamber.
Chinchompas or Ice Barrage speed up kills.

name: Waterfiends
weakness: Crush weapons, heavy ranged and Earth spells

locations.name: Ancient Cavern
locations.how: Dungeon beneath Baxtorian Falls; needs Barbarian Training progress for access.

locations.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
locations.how: Prifddinas dungeon; also gives crystal shard drops.

tips: Immune to poison and venom.
Weak to crush and heavy ranged; resistant to slash/stab and magic.
Drop fiendish ashes 100% of the time.

name: Wyrms

locations.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon (lower level)
locations.how: Fairy ring CIR south of Mount Karuulm, or Rada's blessing 3/4.

locations.name: Wyrmscraig Cavern
locations.how: Needs partial completion of Fallen From Grace.

mustBring: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots (heat protection in Karuulm; not needed with Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary)

food.note: Max hit 13, judgement: low damage taken.

tips: No dragonfire protection needed.
Dragonbane weapons work well.
Immune to poison and venom.

name: Abyssal demons

locations.name: Slayer Tower
locations.how: Slayer ring to Slayer Tower; they are on the upper floors.

mustBring: 85 Slayer is needed to damage them; Teleport anchoring scroll optional (stops forced teleports)
tips: They can teleport you up to 20 tiles; safespotting is not viable.
Turn on Auto Retaliate.
Demonbane weapons work.

name: Cave kraken

locations.name: Kraken Cove
locations.how: Kraken Cove in Kandarin; disturb a whirlpool to fight one.

tips: Needs 87 Slayer and a task to attack.
Ranged does 1/7 damage; melee cannot be used.
Not aggressive until disturbed.

name: Dark beasts

locations.name: Mourner Tunnels
locations.how: Slayer ring teleports straight to the Mourner Tunnels (West Ardougne).

locations.name: Iorwerth Dungeon
locations.how: Prifddinas, after Song of the Elves.

tips: Always aggressive; ignore tolerance.
Protect from Melee is recommended.
Cannons and thralls work.

name: Drakes

locations.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon (middle level)
locations.how: Fairy ring CIR south of Mount Karuulm, or Rada's blessing.

mustBring: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots (heat protection)
Super antifire potion (volcanic breath counts as dragonfire)

food.note: Max hit 15 normal, volcanic breath treated as dragonfire.

tips: Protect from Missiles blocks normal attacks.
Volcanic breath after 7 attacks; step one tile away.
Super antifire lets you keep defender/blowpipe.

name: Hydras

locations.name: Karuulm Slayer Dungeon
locations.how: Fairy ring CIR south of Mount Karuulm, or Rada's blessing.
locations.note: One area only for players on task.

mustBring: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone or granite boots (heat protection)
tips: Style alternates every 3 attacks; flick prayers.
Middle head poison splats three tiles.
Poison immunity halves poison damage.

name: Smoke devils

locations.name: Smoke Devil Dungeon
locations.how: Fairy ring BKP (Feldip Hills, south of Castle Wars).
locations.note: Hide behind bone piles to stack.

mustBring: Slayer helmet, slayer helmet (i) or facemask (required to damage them)

food.note: Max hit 20; Protect from Missiles negates.

tips: Protect from Missiles negates attacks.
Burst/barrage and chinchompas work in the multi area.
Not counted for dust devil tasks.
